description.value: Fortune's Landing Motel is a 30-room courtyard-style property in Enderby with an on-site restaurant, pub, and liquor store — an unusual all-in-one stop for touring cyclists passing through the Shuswap/Okanagan corridor. Guests walk through the restaurant and lounge to reach rooms that overlook a central courtyard with a swimming pool. The property regularly hosts large adventure groups (hikers, skiers) and has received consistent praise for friendly staff and clean rooms.

address.value: 1510 George St, Enderby, BC V0E 1V1, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM phone number and website URL. Room amenities page explicitly lists 'Free high speed wi-fi' and 'Many charging ports to plug in the devices,' confirming those amenities. No bike-specific facilities (storage, tools, wash) are mentioned anywhere on the site; the on-site pub and restaurant is prominently confirmed as an evening food option. A notable discrepancy exists: OSM lists the address as '1510 Highway 97A' while the website consistently shows '1510 George St, Enderby, BC V0E 1V1, Canada' across all pages.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '1510 Highway 97A' but the business website consistently shows '1510 George St, Enderby, BC V0E 1V1, Canada' across all pages. Highway 97A may travel through Enderby as George St, but the OSM address should be reviewed and updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible motel with active website, recent reviews, and on-site food and drink — a clear and useful stop for touring cyclists on Highway 97A.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site pub and restaurant confirmed; multiple reviews reference dinner and breakfast at the property's own pub

Device charging.detail: Accommodations page lists 'Many charging ports to plug in the devices' as a standard room amenity in all room types
